De Beers Unveils 176-Carat Namibian Diamond in Washington

The De Beers Group, in collaboration with Grandview Klein Diamond, has unveiled the Owishi natural diamond, a 176-carat stone from Namibia. The unveiling took place in Washington, D.C.
